title: Tenure Cap on Repeat-Violation Charges — Community Rules & Site Care Resident Terms
content:
The repeat-violation charge under Community Rules & Site Care is capped by tenure, counted in whole calendar months from the move-in date on the Home-Site Lease to the handling date. The cap applies to the sum of every amount making up the charge, once those amounts have been added together.

| Tenure (whole calendar months) | Cap on the summed charge |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | capped at $100.00 |
| 60 or more, fewer than 120 | capped at $140.00 |
| fewer than 60 | uncapped |

The longer tenure band carries the lower cap.

## Hypothetical cases

| Summed charge | Tenure | Charge after the cap |
|---|---|---|
| $187.50 | 130 months | $100.00 |
| $187.50 | 80 months | $140.00 |
| $187.50 | 40 months | $187.50 |
| $120.00 | 130 months | $100.00 |
| $120.00 | 80 months | $120.00 |
| $95.00 | any | $95.00 |

At 119 months the cap is $140.00; at 120 months it is $100.00. At 59 months the sum is uncapped; at 60 months it is capped at $140.00.
